definition_one_sentence: A customer account with at least one non-cancelled order in the last 12 months.
formula_or_rule: count(distinct customer_id) where status <> 'cancelled' and order_date >= current_date - interval 12 months
example: Last non-cancelled order on 2026-03-10: active on 2026-11-25. Only order cancelled in 2026-10: not active.
notes_conflicts: Sales used 6 months and counted cancelled orders. Sales view kept as a separate term: recently active customer (6 months).

definition_one_sentence: What the customer paid for non-cancelled orders, minus refunds, excluding VAT; shipping fees included.
formula_or_rule: (sum(amount paid) - sum(refunds)) / 1.20, on orders with status <> 'cancelled'
example: EUR 120 paid incl. VAT and shipping, no refund: EUR 100. EUR 120 paid, EUR 24 refunded: EUR 80.
notes_conflicts: Sales wanted VAT included (commissions): use gross revenue for that, not net revenue.

definition_one_sentence: A customer who has ordered before but has no non-cancelled order in the last 12 months.
formula_or_rule: has at least 1 non-cancelled order ever AND last non-cancelled order_date < current_date - interval 12 months
example: Last order on 2025-09-01, nothing since: churned on 2026-11-25.
notes_conflicts: Exact opposite of active customer, so the two never overlap. Used as the label of churn_prediction_model.

definition_one_sentence: One customer account on ShopFast, identified by customer_id.
formula_or_rule: 1 row in stg_customers = 1 customer (customer_id unique, not null)
example: customer_id 1042 = one account; the same person with 2 emails = 2 customers.
notes_conflicts: Counts accounts, not people: duplicates of the same person are not merged yet.

definition_one_sentence: One purchase placed by a customer, whatever its status.
formula_or_rule: 1 row in stg_orders = 1 order (order_id unique); status in pending, shipped, delivered, cancelled, returned
notes_conflicts: Cancelled orders are still orders, but are excluded from active customer and net revenue.
